openings.claim: Use conservative decision bounds to direct adjudication and permit advance or reject only when every remaining label assignment supports that decision.
openings.delta: Replace dependence on provisional aggregate gains with a script or spreadsheet carrying per-record candidate-minus-baseline correctness contributions and slice bounds. Equal predictions contribute zero; unadjudicated flagged rows with differing predictions conservatively contribute between minus one and plus one. Adjudications fix contributions. Log selected identifiers, selection reasons, responses, unavailable attempts, allowance use and elapsed time.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, a fixed slice-stratified sixteen-row review using corrected point totals, bounds should prevent unsupported threshold decisions when residual label uncertainty could reverse them. They need not produce more resolved decisions or require fewer adjudications.
openings.probe: Run both workflows on matched copies, with identical preselected withheld rows. Select accessible rows whose possible contributions can change the total threshold of four or a slice threshold of minus two; use record-ID tie breaks. Advance when the total lower bound is at least four and every slice lower bound is at least minus two. Reject when the total upper bound is below four or any slice upper bound is below minus two. Otherwise continue within sixteen successful adjudications and seventy minutes, then report unresolved with affected slices and remaining bounds. Unavailable attempts consume no allowance and remain logged. Freeze both reports before opening the full-label key; compare decisions, residual uncertainty, adjudications and time.
assumptions: Unflagged supplied labels remain fixed for this review; if their status is also disputed, these bounds cannot certify a decision.
The local environment must implement and verify conservative bounds within seventy minutes; otherwise report unresolved.

The rival is defeated only by demonstrated unsupported decisions or comparable certainty at greater cost. If both remain unresolved, no advantage is established. Withheld or numerous pivotal rows may prevent resolution.

assessment: This is a bounded review probe, not deployment evidence. Apparent improvement remains provisional until the unchanged acceptance rule is supported; disagreement alone does not establish label error.
